mang_0: Parama purusha hari govinda | Shrihari narayana govinda: O Supreme Being, Hari, Govinda! Lord Sri Hari, Narayana, Govinda!
mang_1: Nishiveshadasurana asuva tolagiside: You took away the life of the demon (Hayagriva/Sankhasura) disguised in darkness.
mang_2: Kusumasharanapita govinda: O Govinda, Father of Manmatha (Kama), the one who holds flower arrows.
mang_3: Rasapooritha shruti musulisadale tande: You retrieved the sacred Vedas filled with divine wisdom without allowing them to be ruined or lost.
mang_4: Bisajasambhavagitte govinda: O Govinda, You restored those Vedas back to Brahma (the one born of the lotus). [Matsya Avatara]
mang_5: Jatanadolamruthamathanadi mandara: During the careful churning of the nectar ocean, You held up the Mandara mountain.
mang_6: Parvatavanuddhariside govinda: O Govinda, You supported and lifted up the huge mountain on Your back.
mang_7: Shatakratuvina siri hatavaagiralu: When the wealth and glory of Indra (Shatakratu) was lost to the demons,
mang_8: Mahonnatiyannaidisikotte govinda: O Govinda, You restored supreme glory and prosperity back to Indra. [Kurma Avatara]
mang_9: Bhoothalaverasi rasaathalakiluhi: When the Earth was dragged down into the depths of Rasatala (the underworld),
mang_10: Paathaaladolu kanda govinda: O Govinda, You tracked down and found the Earth in the nether regions.
mang_11: Aatanodane kaadi aatana gelidu: Fighting fiercely against that demon (Hiranyaksha) and defeating him,
mang_12: Maheethalavanu tande govinda: O Govinda, You rescued and brought the Earth back to safety. [Varaha Avatara]
mang_13: Durula daityana seeli karula maaleya: Tearing open the wicked demon (Hiranyakashipu) and wearing his intestines as a garland,
mang_14: Mungorallolu dhariside govinda: O Govinda, You wore that garland around Your neck.
mang_15: Garalakantharanu karavetti pogalalu: When Shiva (the blue-throated Lord) raised his hands in praise,
mang_16: Taralagabhayavitte govinda: O Govinda, You granted absolute fearlessness to the child devotee Prahlada. [Narasimha Avatara]
mang_17: Vaamananagi nisseema baliya kaiya: Incarnating as the dwarf Vamana, You asked for land from the boundlessly generous King Bali,
mang_18: Bhoomidaanava konde govinda: O Govinda, You accepted the gift of land spanning three steps.
mang_19: Taamarasaanghriyolu brahmaanda odedu: Expanding Your lotus-like foot to break open the cosmic shell,
mang_20: Vyomagangeya pette govinda: O Govinda, You birthed the celestial Ganges flowing from the sky. [Vamana Avatara]
mang_21: Surapashuvina rushivarana tapada bahu: Through the severe penance of the great sage (Jamadagni), owner of the divine Kamadhenu,
mang_22: Karakamaladalidda govinda: O Govinda, You manifested in his family holding an axe in Your lotus hands.
mang_23: Tarahariside vasundhareya patnitva: You rid the Earth of tyrannical kings and bestowed ownership of the land,
mang_24: Bhoosuragorigoppisikotte govinda: O Govinda, You handed over the kingdom to the pious Brahmins. [Parashurama Avatara]
mang_25: Trinayananolida raavanana shirava: You severed the heads of Ravana, who was blessed by the three-eyed Lord Shiva,
mang_26: Ranadalli kedahide govinda: O Govinda, You struck him down in battle.
mang_27: Ene enisade sadgunapooritha: Without hesitation or bias, You bestowed noble sovereignty upon the virtuous,
mang_28: Vibheeshanaagitte padaviya govinda: O Govinda, You crowned Vibheeshana as the King. [Rama Avatara]
mang_29: Kaaginele aadikeshavaraya govinda: O Govinda, Lord Adikeshava of Kaginele, You protect all righteous devotees!
mang_30: Sadhugalige sakalaishvarya vaagiha: You remain the ultimate wealth and sanctuary for all saintly souls.
